item.title: Text Blocks (JEP 378): Multiline Strings Without the Escape Hell
item.description:
Finalized in Java 15 (JEP 378). Available in all Java 15+ releases, including Java 17. Previous previews: Java 13 (JEP 355) and Java 14 (JEP 368).
The Problem: Embedded Strings in Java Writing multi-line strings in Java has always been painful:
// JSON — a wall of escape sequences and concatenation String json = "{
" + " \"name\": \"Alice\",
" + " \"role\": \"engineer\",
" + " \"active\": true
